# Third-party material

The recorded replays in `reports/replay-*.html` bundle the AgentPitch match viewer and native match metadata. Upstream: https://github.com/gangtao/AgentPitch, commit `ce2ab34a64e28315bd0fb5c41864cd5303b7439e`. AgentPitch is licensed under Apache-2.0; its license is retained in `agentpitch/`. Replay labels and embedded Baku strategy data were added by this project.

The AWS deployment template retains its separate MIT-0 license and provenance under `deployment/template/`. These third-party files are covered by their respective licenses, rather than the project's own MIT-0 notice.
